entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: Turbulent time on Innistrad culminating in Avacyn's death, rising madness and Emrakul's summoning.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel and Innistrad's protector, driven mad and destroyed by Sorin.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan drawn to Innistrad and imprisoned in its silver moon.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker lithomancer who attacked Innistrad out of fury at Sorin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Vampire planeswalker, Avacyn's creator, defeated and encased in stone by Nahiri.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison that broke, and in which Sorin once imprisoned Nahiri.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, ravaged by loose Eldrazi.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's ancestral home, attacked by Nahiri.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Cunning vampire who agreed to rally vampires if Sorin destroyed Avacyn.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Place where Avacyn was born and destroyed.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who battled Avacyn and helped imprison Emrakul.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who battled Avacyn and helped imprison Emrakul.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who raised undead legions to shield the living.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Only archangel untouched by the corruption, rallied the sane angels.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: Blessing that transformed werewolves into Wolfir, unraveled with Avacyn's madness.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: Battle in which Emrakul was imprisoned.

entities.name: Cryptoliths
entities.description: Stones Nahiri raised to warp leylines and draw Emrakul.

events.summary: Nahiri, furious at Sorin, attacks Markov Manor and imprisons its vampires in the walls.
Nahiri raises cryptoliths to draw Emrakul; their distortion drives angels, even Avacyn, mad.
events.quote: Even Avacyn, Innistrad’s great protector, fell under the growing corruption.

events.summary: Avacyn and corrupted angels slaughter the faithful under the Harvest Moon.
events.quote: slaughtering the faithful she once vowed to defend

events.summary: Avacyn's madness unravels the Cursemute and many wolfir revert and kill.
events.quote: Many wolfir reverted to their savage forms

events.summary: Sorin returns to his ruined home, sees Nahiri's message and seeks Olivia Voldaren's help.
events.quote: he sought help from the cunning Olivia Voldaren

events.summary: Sorin finds Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral battling Jace and Tamiyo and is forced to destroy her.
events.quote: Sorin was forced to destroy his beloved creation

events.summary: Emrakul arrives as Avacyn falls; Sorin and Olivia gather vampires and Liliana raises undead.
Sorin confronts Nahiri at Markov Manor and is defeated, encased in stone.
events.quote: Nahiri encased him in stone as poetic punishment

events.summary: Sigarda rallies the sane angels, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the silver moon at the Battle of Thraben.
events.quote: Emrakul was finally imprisoned within Innistrad’s silver moon

relations.quote: unmaking Avacyn in the same place where she was born
Furious at Sorin Markov for abandoning their pact to protect Zendikar
Olivia agreed to rally the vampires
